title: Mary and the saints
tagline: The Marian dogmas, the Rosary, praying to the saints, images and relics, and the charge of “worship”.
whyItMatters: Mary and the saints are among the first things non-Catholics question and among the most loved things for Catholics. Good answers start from Christ.

mindset.tip: Say clearly that Catholics adore God alone and honour Mary and the saints. (CCC 971, 2132)
Remember that early Reformers such as Luther honoured Mary; the gap is smaller than many think.
Ask what “worship” means to your friend before you reply. (Revelation 22:8-9)
Show how each Marian teaching protects the truth about Jesus.
